summary: Tested FeaturedProperties staggered reveal animation on homepage. All acceptance criteria pass: (1) Before scroll, all 3 cards had opacity:0, visibility:hidden, transform matrix(1,0,0,1,0,46) — confirming GSAP autoAlpha:0,y:46 initial state. (2) After scrolling to section, all 3 cards reach opacity:1, visibility:visible, transform:none, and inline style is cleared (clearProps working) — so hover:-translate-y-1.5 will function correctly on hover. (3) VIEW PROPERTY links resolve to /properties/<slug> (verified chelsea link). (4) Under prefers-reduced-motion:reduce, cards are immediately opacity:1, visibility:visible with no reliance on scroll. (5) No console errors. (6) No horizontal overflow at 390px (docW=winW=390).
context_for_next_testing_agent: FeaturedProperties reveal spark fully verified in both normal and reduced-motion modes. Initial autoAlpha:0 confirmed pre-scroll, cards animate in with clearProps allowing hover transform, reduced-motion path correctly skips animation showing cards immediately. No further action needed.
